category: research testbed - free bare metal and storage nodes

free_tier.stated: 534 nodes across KVM@TACC, CHI@UC, CHI@TACC, CHI@NRP; 62 nodes with >1TB total storage, dedicated 'storage' (20) and 'storage_nvme' (10) node classes, plus 297 nodes at 400GB-1TB
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

egress.terms: free within allocation; no published byte meter

interface_detail: OpenStack API (Nova/Cinder/Blazar), CLI, Jupyter; ssh to instances
tooling: python-chi, openstackclient, blazar reservations, Trovi artifacts, Daypass for artifact reproduction
chaining: bare-metal reservation -> local NVMe -> object store you run yourself
limits_note: PI status is the binding constraint and is 'limited to faculty and research staff at US-based academic institutions'. International PIs are supported only as 'a limited number ... with ongoing, active collaborations with scientists in the US'. Students explicitly excluded except NSF GRFP holders. Accounts deactivate after 120 days' inactivity. AUP bans 'commercial purposes, financial gain, personal gain' and cryptocurrency mining. FPGA resources additionally refuse residents or citizens of Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Sudan, Syria.
reliability_note: Project expiry immediately revokes all access and the allocation; storage is not offered as a durable service.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

extras.agent_focus: Marketplaces and networks where storage or bandwidth is contributed by third parties for free or near-free. Two directions probed: (1) BUY side - can you consume contributed bandwidth/storage cheaply; (2) SUPPLY side - the arbitrage question, whether contributing a disk earns storage credit at better than the retail rate. Also research testbeds that hand out whole physical nodes with multi-TB local disk (CloudLab, Chameleon, FABRIC, Emulab) and community mesh networks (Guifi, Freifunk, NYC Mesh). Decided per candidate by computing 20 TiB stored + 1 TiB/day egress against that path's actual tariff.
